text: Terrible. I've never seen a clinic this inefficient. Long wait times, no communication whatsoever. Even a filling was done incorrectly, and when I pointed it out, they said that tooth was decayed, even though I'd previously mentioned sensitivity in that tooth. They said there was no decay and that they'd check again during the scaling, but then didn't check at all during the procedure, saying the attending dentist had informed them to fill that particular tooth. The service is awful. The reviews on their page are great, but what makes them so bad? They didn't even inform patients about their lunch break, making us wait for hours. When I asked about it, they were rude, and even adjusting my seat almost made me fall over. They apologized, but the assistant was laughing. Most recently, the tooth that was eroding is still sensitive. I had to ask if it was really filled, and they looked confused before finally saying yes. In short, they initially said there were no cavities, but after filling the wrong tooth, they said that one too, and another. So, how did they notice the decay after the filling was done incorrectly? Initially, I didn't see any cavities. After the problems started, they barely called to schedule an appointment. Are they blaming me for everything that happened? I've noticed everything they did. I tried to ignore everything, but now I can't. But you really made a mistake right up to the last minute. You didn't acknowledge the lack of attention to the patient, but instead acted like you were having fun, gossiping about others. And during dental treatment, you should at least reduce the gossiping. I know it's normal for some people to do this, but you should use the time while treating the patient to pay attention to the service provider. Don't just rush through the procedure and then gossip amongst yourselves.
